title: Axis Bank CEO's AI Push Signals Slower Hiring Ahead
excerpt: Axis Bank CEO Amitabh Chaudhry expects its investments in AI to help it expand without growing headcount at the same pace. He said this in an exclusive inter...
content_html:
Bloomberg

Wed, September 9, 2026 at 7:23 AM MST

Axis Bank CEO Amitabh Chaudhry expects its investments in AI to help it expand without growing headcount at the same pace. He said this in an exclusive interview with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin.
